title: pinus montana subsp. mughus
intro: Pinus montana subsp. mughus, commonly known as Mountain Pine, is a subspecies of coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of the Balkan Peninsula. The health benefits of Mountain Pine include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pine include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to relieve congestion and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Pine include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
